risk: Expansion to too many surveys before validating the framework
consequence: Unfinished mappings and weak quality control
mitigation: Restrict MVP to PaRIS and EHIS and require gates before each extension
Inventory licences files and design before committing analyses
Independent multidimensional assessment before empirical inspection

risk: PaRIS target population cannot be reproduced in comparator
mitigation: Use population funnel separate estimands and NOT_ASSESSABLE where required

risk: Weights strata or clusters absent or mishandled
mitigation: Inventory design variables and estimate within survey-country first

consequence: Survey effects confounded with temporal change
mitigation: Predefine period compatibility and sensitivity; avoid causal attribution

risk: Previous screening criteria differ from WP1 eligibility
consequence: Invalid PRISMA flow or inherited selection bias
mitigation: Re-evaluate the corpus under the registered WP1 protocol
Peer-review syntax and test sentinel articles before execution

risk: DIF or linking applied without anchors
mitigation: Require common construct shared items anchors invariance and sensitivity

consequence: Unauthorised disclosure or unusable public outputs
mitigation: Keep microdata local and publish metadata code and aggregate outputs only
Do not label mappings or WP1 selection as independently reviewed until assigned

risk: Multisource processing exceeds available secure infrastructure
mitigation: Estimate cost after MVP and use source-specific local pipelines
